task: I'm the best man at my brother Dan's wedding Saturday and need a 2-minute toast. We met in college, he's always been the one who fixes things for everyone, and he proposed on a frozen lake in Minnesota. Keep it warm, a little funny, and not too long.

Write a letter to my city council about the pothole on Maple Ave between 4th and 5th that has been there since March. It's the size of a bathtub, two cars have damaged tires, and I've called public works three times with no fix. Make it firm but polite and ask for a repair date.

Draft a short text to my U10 team parents: Saturday's 9am game against Riverside is cancelled because of flooding on the field, and the makeup is Sunday 2pm at Hollis Park, field 3. Ask them to confirm by tonight whether their kid can make it.

I need a listing description for a house I'm selling. Specs: 3 bed, 2 bath, 1,640 sq ft, built 1958, renovated kitchen with quartz counters, new roof 2023, big backyard with a shed, quiet street near the elementary school, asking $489,000. Keep it under 150 words and don't oversell.

Write a LinkedIn About section for me. I'm a certified veterinary technician with 9 years in emergency and critical care, I'm strongest with anesthesia monitoring and ICU nursing, and I'm now looking to move into a practice management role. Write it in first person, around 120 words.

Write an email to members of our hiking club reminding them about Sunday's trip to Eagle Peak. Details: meet 7:00am at the Pine St trailhead, 9.5 miles with 2,100 ft of elevation gain, bring 3 liters of water and microspikes, and everyone must sign the liability waiver online before Friday. Keep it friendly but clear that the waiver is mandatory.

As CTO of a 40-person startup, I need to tell everyone that the December offsite in Austin is cancelled because of budget cuts after our funding round came in smaller than planned. We're going to do a virtual holiday lunch instead and I want to acknowledge people were excited about it. Write the Slack announcement, about 150 words, direct but not cold.

Write a grant request email to the Harlow Family Foundation on behalf of the Eastside Elementary library. We need $12,000 to replace 800 outdated books and add a reading nook for kids in grades K-2, and 340 students use the library each week. Our contact is Marisol Ortega, and the program director's name is Ben Adeyemi.

Write a Craigslist-style ad for subletting my room from January 15 to June 30. It's a furnished bedroom in a 3-bedroom apartment near the Green Line, $850/month including utilities, shared bathroom, I'm a quiet nurse who works nights, and I'd prefer a non-smoker. Keep it short and clear.

I'm the booking contact for a 4-piece indie folk band called The Larkins. Write an email to the Copper Room, which holds about 200 people, asking if they have a Friday night open in March or April. Mention our two albums, that we bring a draw of about 120 from our mailing list, and that we're flexible on guarantee versus door split.

A coworker, Priya, lost her father last week. I want to write a short handwritten card for the team to sign, something warm and sincere that doesn't sound generic. Her dad was a retired machinist who she often mentioned visiting on weekends. About 60 to 80 words please.

Write a web event description for our Saturday tasting at Northfield Brewing. Details: 5pm to 8pm, $25 per person includes five 4oz pours and a snack board, we're featuring our new hazy IPA and a seasonal pumpkin stout, and tickets are limited to 60 people and sell through our website. Make it inviting and about 100 words.

Write a note to my daughter's piano teacher, Mrs. Chen, asking to move Lily's Thursday 4pm lesson to Tuesday 4:30pm starting next week, since she has a new soccer practice. Tell her Lily is really enjoying the Clementi sonatina and we'd appreciate it if we could keep the same lesson length. Keep it polite and brief.

I'm a volunteer docent at the Riverside Art Museum and I need a spoken 2-minute intro for my tour of the Early American gallery. The tour covers three works: a Hudson River School landscape from 1851, a portrait of a Boston merchant, and a quilt from 1830s Vermont. Write it conversationally so I can read it aloud comfortably.

Write a welcome email to new students at my yoga studio. Include the studio policies I pasted: arrive 10 minutes early, cancel bookings 4 hours before class or lose the credit, no shoes on the mats, and first-timers get one free class with code WELCOME1. Keep it warm and organized so people can scan it quickly.
